name: Catholic Charities Dioceses of Camden, Inc.: veteran housing help (SSVF)
organization: Catholic Charities Dioceses of Camden, Inc.
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 12-NJ-053): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households. Serves: Atlantic County, Camden County, Cape May County, Cumberland County, Gloucester County, Salem County.
next_step: Call SSVF intake with your county and housing situation: whether you are homeless now or at risk of losing housing, and who lives with you. A second intake number is listed: 609-592-9896.
constraints: Serves only the areas listed; check that yours is included. Veteran-household, income and housing-status screening applies.
County and intake details come from VA’s FY26 SSVF provider intake list; confirm current service when calling.
